title: build(deps): bump konva from 10.9.0 to 10.9.1
intent: Routine Dependabot currency, no advisory. konva 10.9.0 -> 10.9.1 in packages/client, a patch release (2026-10-31) of rendering fixes: TextPath gradients/patterns drawn in glyph 'style space', text underline/line-through colour when text has no fill, fill-pattern transform applied on each get instead of baked into the cached pattern, negative cornerRadius clamped to 0, and CSS filter-string fallbacks moved from a core lookup to registration by the filter modules. Authored by hand because Dependabot cannot author a manifest (CBSP21-NOBORROW-001). The Dependabot branch was based on bb90047e; origin/main (53a86f0b: #491 tailwind, #492 supabase, #495) was merged in without force-push and the two client files were re-resolved as main + the konva delta only, dropping Dependabot's 16 peer-flag-only lockfile flips per main's convention since #432 (ec88eedd).
behavior_change: None observable on any path the app uses. Lockfile audited by parsing both package-lock.json trees and comparing every `packages` entry in full, not by reading the diff view: against origin/main 53a86f0b the lock moves exactly one node_modules entry, konva 10.9.0 -> 10.9.1 (version, resolved, integrity only; same key set, no dependency map), plus the root dependencies.konva range ^10.9.0 -> ^10.9.1. Entry count 405 -> 405; zero added, zero removed, zero other entries touched. Consumer trace from src/main.ts (static + dynamic imports, @/ alias): konva is LIVE via composables/useKonvaCanvas.ts <- views/cam/NeckView.vue <- router and composables/useWoodGrain.ts <- views/art-studio/InlayWorkspaceShell.vue <- router; composables/useExportDxf.ts and design-utilities/lutherie/neck/drawCamOverlay.ts (the only cornerRadius user, literal 2) are unreachable. No file uses TextPath, textDecoration, filter strings, Konva.Filters, Transformer or cache(). The changed fill-pattern and gradient code paths ARE reached (useWoodGrain fillPattern* and addEdgeShading fillLinearGradient*), but the new _styleTransform is only set by TextPath, so for Path shapes _toStyleSpace(p) returns p and the pattern matrix is built from the same ops. Confirmed empirically: draw-call trace A/B (every 2D-context call and property set on scene and hit canvases, Math.random seeded for hit colour keys) of the live routes' shape configurations -- Path with fill pattern including a setter-driven redraw, both edge-shading gradient Paths, dashed/closed Lines, Rect, Circle, Arc, rotated/offset/aligned Text -- is byte-identical between 10.9.0 and 10.9.1 (467 calls each).

diff_articulation.what_changed: packages/client/package.json moves konva ^10.9.0 -> ^10.9.1 (one line). package-lock.json moves node_modules/konva 10.9.0 -> 10.9.1 and the root range; nothing else. Against origin/main the PR diff is 5 lines across the two client files.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Dependabot currency, stated plainly. No existing manifest covers this diff; the prior konva manifest (konva 10.9.0) would cover these two files, and borrowing it is what CBSP21-NOBORROW-001 refuses.
